title: Natural-inbound industrial channel kill sweep
purpose: After OMS-017 showed that a real service business can still fail the Rooter thesis when demand requires provider-led selling, Scan 009 starts only from recurring events where buyers already enter a transaction channel naturally. It then asks whether a narrow post-incumbent routing residual remains.
scan_rule: A mature direct rental/service/procurement/MRO route closes the generic pattern even when both sides are active.
Do not retain a candidate merely because the event is recurring or expensive.

candidates_tested.pattern: Temporary/emergency generator capacity after outage, construction or project demand
candidates_tested.demand_flow: NATURAL / BUYER ALREADY SEARCHES AND RENTS
candidates_tested.supply_flow: NATURAL / LOCAL RENTAL PROVIDERS SEEK UTILIZATION
incumbent_evidence: Xuzhou-facing providers already advertise local generator rental with broad power ranges, flexible duration and rapid response.
Rental can be purchased by day/month/project and providers already supply transport/service/operator support.
Current rental providers already offer temporary/mobile air-compressor capacity, flexible leasing and project service.
The minimum service unit is already a short-duration rental rather than full asset ownership.

candidates_tested.pattern: On-site dynamic balancing after rotating-equipment vibration
incumbent_evidence: Direct industrial providers already sell on-site no-disassembly dynamic balancing.
Current services describe rapid correction, field diagnosis and report/result delivery.

candidates_tested.pattern: Emergency third-party sorting/rework/containment after supplier quality failure
candidates_tested.demand_flow: STRONG / NATURAL AFTER BATCH QUALITY EVENT
incumbent_evidence: Jiangsu/China quality-service providers already operate multi-city or nationwide on-site sorting, rework, resident inspection and controlled-shipping networks.
Current providers advertise 7x24 response, replacement personnel, on-site execution and multi-site service capacity.
candidates_tested.missing_edge: NONE OBSERVED AT GENERIC ROUTING LAYER

candidates_tested.pattern: Small recurring repair/maintenance jobs that naturally enter procurement
incumbent_evidence: Xuzhou-area buyers already use fixed-supplier frameworks for零星维修.
Industrial equipment maintenance is already purchased through inquiry/comparison procurement and bid aggregation.
ZKH already exposes a very large SKU universe, warehouse/service network and marketplace supply.
欧贝 already provides inquiry, supplier collaboration and emergency/shared-inventory functions.
Other mature MRO platforms already provide procurement, matching and fulfillment infrastructure.
candidates_tested.missing_edge: NONE OBSERVED AT GENERIC PROCUREMENT LAYER

candidates_tested.pattern: Same-day/overnight machining for urgent replacement or project parts
incumbent_evidence: Current Jiangsu/Xuzhou-facing machining providers advertise one-piece work, rapid quote and same-day/24h urgent processing.
Online manufacturing platforms already productize 24h or fastest-24h delivery.

candidates_tested.pattern: Small material quantity / offcut / net-size industrial material mismatch
incumbent_evidence: 慧拼钢 already converts coil-scale production into demand-side order pooling/nesting and net-size delivery.
Industrial surplus/offcut material already flows through auction/market channels.
Specialty material suppliers already support low-MOQ or cut-to-size supply in many categories.

additional_pattern_kills.reason: Regional digital warehouse/distribution and industrial fastener supply already provide local inventory + rapid fulfillment; no narrow post-incumbent residual was evidenced.
Xuzhou already has a large enterprise-service platform and institutional appeal/coordination channels. Government orchestration does not prove a private commercial gap.
Current Xuzhou cross-border service infrastructure already integrates multiple trade-service functions, and generic overseas field/local-evidence routing was previously closed.

material_learning: Starting from natural order flow is necessary but not sufficient.
High-frequency urgent industrial events are often exactly where incumbent direct-service, rental, framework-procurement and MRO platforms are strongest.

The next scan should not continue enumerating standard industrial services. It should search for value loss inside an already-running flow: downgrade, discard, rework, stranded residual capacity, acceptance mismatch or transaction-size mismatch that incumbent routes still leave unresolved.
scan_conclusion.current_best_next_truth: Fresh Scan 010 should shift from service/rental/MRO categories to repeated partial flows where value is visibly destroyed or stranded despite an existing transaction channel. Preserve the same hard rules: bilateral action, observed workaround/cost, narrow post-incumbent missing edge, high reachability, low permission, clear money flow, self-propulsion and operator exit.
